definition: An EC2 instance in an EMR on EC2 cluster.
The distributed file system in which EMR core nodes store cluster data.
A script that customizes EMR nodes before cluster applications are installed.
A unit of work submitted to an EMR cluster for processing by installed software.
A component that manages resources for applications in an EMR cluster.
An EC2 instance using spare capacity that EC2 can interrupt when it needs the capacity back.
A node configuration that can mix EC2 instance types and purchasing options.
A Hadoop connector for reading and writing data in Amazon S3.
An EMR file system that lets Hadoop applications read and write files in Amazon S3.
